descriptionChirho: The Hebrew noun פְּנִינִים (peninim) referring to precious stones or gems, variously translated as pearls, corals, rubies, or jewels depending on the version. The exact identification of this stone is uncertain in biblical scholarship, but the word consistently denotes something of great value used in comparison ('more precious than X'). All four clusters are the same lexeme: comparative forms (eng: than jewels/than pearls, spa: más que perlas, hin: मोतियों से अधिक, arb: مِنْ اللُّؤْلُؤِ, kor: 진주들보다, swa: zaidi ya lulu), absolute (eng: pearls, spa: rubíes, arb: لآلِئَ, kor: 보석들이), ketiv variant, and the 'corals' rendering (eng: more than corals, spa: más que corales, swa: kuliko marijani). The variation in translation reflects lexicographic uncertainty, not separate senses.
